title: End on a High Note
description: To create great memories: - Finish strong: End tasks or experiences with something positive. - Celebrate small wins: After completing a tough task, reward yourself with something enjoyable. - Pause to reflect: Take a moment to focus on the highlights before ending your day. Example: After a meeting, share a positive takeaway with your team to leave a good impression.
